meta.title: Northern Pakistan winter climate 1970-2010 (ERA5-Land reanalysis)
meta.season: Winter = December-February (DJF); season totals summed over DJF
meta.estimated_note: 1974 is flagged estimated in the supplied run (no complete source data). It is shown hatched and is excluded from every trend and correlation here.
meta.resolution: 0.25° tiles (~25 km), ERA5-Land aggregated by the notebook
meta.cover_note: Snow cover is supplied labelled % but runs 0-10,000; it is divided by 100 here (0-100 %).
meta.cap_note: ERA5-Land holds glacier cells at a fixed snow store (snow depth 3,333 cm, SWE 10,000 mm). Tiles and regions with glaciers (Karakoram above all) show these caps, not measured snow.
meta.trend_note: Trend = least-squares slope over the observed winters 1970-2010 (1974 excluded), per decade. Not tested for significance.
meta.corr_note: Correlation = Pearson r between winter air temperature and snow depth, year to year, observed winters only.
meta.source: NGT ERA5 winter run (ERA5_Pakistan_results_winter): ERA5-Land monthly reanalysis via Google Earth Engine, aggregated to 0.25° tiles inside the Pakistan border
meta.reanalysis_note: Reanalysis is a model reconstruction of past weather, not station measurements. Not validated against observations here.
